scope.market_definition: The global smartwatch market encompasses the distribution and retail channels through which smartwatches are sold to consumers and businesses. Participants include authorized distributors, wholesalers, electronics distributors, mobile device distributors, wearable distributors, authorized dealers, retailers, retail chains, value-added resellers (VARs), channel partners, service partners, repair partners, and resellers. The market is global in scope, covering all regions.

value_chain_layers.description: Companies that purchase smartwatches in bulk from manufacturers and sell to retailers, VARs, or other resellers. Includes broadline distributors, specialized electronics distributors, and mobile/wearable-focused distributors.

Companies that sell smartwatches directly to end consumers through physical stores, online platforms, or both. Includes big-box retailers, online marketplaces, specialty stores, and authorized dealers.
Companies that add value through integration, customization, or after-sales services. Includes VARs, channel partners, service/repair partners, and resellers.

out_of_scope: Component suppliers (e.g., display, battery, chipset makers)
Unrelated electronics (e.g., laptops, smartphones without wearables)
